sites.description: See your assigned sites and today's schedule.
sites.emptyHint: Sites appear here once a project manager invites you.

access.title: Crew visibility
access.hint: The crew sees only what you turn on (view only). Everything is off by default.

showSchedule.label: Schedule
showSchedule.hint: Show the site schedule and send change notifications to the crew.

showDesigns.label: Confirmed designs
showDesigns.hint: Show previews and originals of confirmed designs.

showMaterials.label: Confirmed materials
showMaterials.hint: Show spec, quantity and location of confirmed materials. Prices stay hidden.

photoAutoPublic.label: Publish crew photos immediately
photoAutoPublic.hint: When on, crew photos are visible to the customer right away. When off, you review them before publishing.
